title: Chapter 654 - 654 All Possess Special Abilities; Initial Fog!
content:
Chapter 654 - 654 All Possess Special Abilities; Initial Fog!

Chapter 654 - 654 All Possess Special Abilities; Initial Fog!

654 All Possess Special Abilities; Initial Fog!

Some people’s veins were throbbing, and their muscles were bulging.

Water gathered above someone’s head.

Someone was surrounded by flames.

…

These were all the marks of a special ability user.

Moreover, as time passed, the changes in the students became more and more obvious.

Among them, Xia Xue’s change was the most significant.

Xia Xue seemed to have a strong suction force and absorbed the white fog crazily.

It even formed several visible whirlpools.

Gradually, Xia Xue’s body burst out a gorgeous golden light—pure and dazzling.

A moment later, the white fog dissipated.

All the students looked at each other, their faces blank.

Immediately after, there was unconcealable excitement.

Someone waved his hand casually and condensed a few drops of water in front of him.

Someone opened his mouth and spat out a wisp of flame.

Someone threw a punch, and the tree in front of him shook violently.

…

“Water attribute power!”

“Fire attribute power!”

“I have great strength!”

“I have a special ability!”

“That’s great!”

Everyone shouted excitedly and jumped around like children.

Xia Xue rushed into Lin Fan’s arms and said excitedly, “I’ve become a special ability user!”

But soon, her face turned red and she quickly dodged to the side.

Lin Fan looked at her shy face, and his lips curled up.

He did not expect that such a thing could happen after gathering some energy.

…

In the live broadcast room…

Countless comments kept rolling.

Youth Never Comes: [F*ck! What happened just now? All of them have special abilities?]

Sword Wielding: [Fire ability, water ability, earth ability, strength! I want to go to the forbidden area too. I want to become a special ability user too!]

Time Traveler: [May I ask what exactly was that white fog?]

Heartthrob Like the Sea: [I want to get into Jiangbei University! I want to study hard! If a friend wants to play games with me, I’ll block them! If a beauty wants to watch a movie with me, I’ll tell her to get lost!]

Song: [Xia Xue, what ability do you have?]

Emperor of Emperors: [Heavens! I’m not envious at all. I just want to say, well done!]

Hello Everyone: [My goal is to get into Jiangbei University! I want to become a special ability user too!]

…

The purpose of Class 2011 entering the forbidden area this time was for training.

The second was to obtain special abilities.

Now, the students had already stayed in the forbidden area for several days. They had suffered some hardships and obtained some training.

All of them had obtained special abilities too.

It could be said that this trip to the forbidden area was complete.

Perhaps it was because they had obtained special abilities, but the fatigue on everyone’s faces disappeared without a trace.

In the next two days, the students chatted as they walked. They occasionally experienced their special abilities. The atmosphere was extremely relaxed.

Most of them were smiling—except for Li Dongqiang.

Li Dongqiang also inhaled the white fog and obtained a special ability.

However, he had no chance to help his classmates anymore.

If he could not help his classmates, he would not be able to get gratitude tokens.

This scenario made him look like he wanted to laugh and sigh at the same time.

…

Two days passed in a flash.

A week of exploration in the forbidden area came to an end.

At this moment, the form teacher, Qin Chuan, and the man in black were standing at the entrance of the forbidden area while chatting.

“How many people do you think will reach E-class from my class?” Qin Chuan asked.

“Two people?” The man in black laughed. “One person? Maybe not even one.”

“How much did we say we would bet?” asked Qin Chuan. “100 World Coins? Or 50 World Coins?”

The man in black laughed so hard that he almost choked. “It’s 20,000 World Coins!”

“20,000?” Qin Chuan’s eyes widened in disbelief.

He wanted to say something.

Suddenly, some sounds came from the forest not far away.

“They’re back!” the man in black said.

After a pause, he reminded him again, “Don’t even think about going back on your word!”

Then, a large group of students gradually appeared.

Qin Chuan quickly put away the frustration in his heart and swept his gaze over the students. Seeing that not a single one of them was missing and that they did not seem to have suffered any injuries, he could not help but heave a sigh of relief.

Jiangbei University allowed some casualties in the forbidden area.

However, regardless of whether it was because he was worried about trouble or because he cared about his students, Qin Chuan did not wish for such a thing to happen.

When Qin Chuan saw the students, the students also saw him and quickened their pace. They ran toward Qin Chuan.

Then, all the students started shouting excitedly.

“Teacher, I have a special ability!”

“Teacher, I’ve mastered the fire ability!”

“I can control soil!”

“I can condense water!”

…

The students shouted as they used their corresponding abilities.

Instantly, Qin Chuan and the black-robed man’s mouths were agape. Their faces were filled with shock.

Under normal circumstances, just like what the man in black said, at most, two or three people would become E-class special ability users.

Qin Chuan said that there would be more than five of them, which was definitely a rare sight.

As for how difficult it was, in the past ten years, no class had ever achieved that.

Therefore, even though Qin Chuan owed the men in black 10,000 World Coins, the black-robed man still agreed to continue betting with Qin Chuan.

After all, it was a bargain to get 20,000 World Coins just like that.

In the end, what was the situation now?

Everyone in the class had become a special ability user!

They could even vaguely sense that a small number of students were not only the lowest E-class special ability users but had also become D-class or even C-class!

What was going on?

After a long while, Qin Chuan finally reacted and stuttered, “Ah… Not bad.”

Not bad?

How could this be considered not bad?

It was simply a miracle!

“How did you guys obtain these special abilities?” asked Qin Chuan.

Hence, Zhang Feng explained the general situation.

When he mentioned the sudden appearance of the white fog, the pupils of Qin Chuan and the black-robed man constricted. They exclaimed in surprise, “Initial Fog!”

“Teacher, what’s the Initial Fog?”

Many students pricked up their ears. Clearly, they were also filled with curiosity.

Qin Chuan thought for a moment and said, “It’s said that a thousand years ago, the great Lin Fan encountered a mysterious white ball and suffered a terrifying attack. He died on the spot.

“It was also at that time that a thick white fog suddenly appeared in Hua Nation.

“It was this white fog that gave many people special abilities. There are even legends that two people became immortals because they inhaled a lot of white fog!”

At this point, Qin Chuan’s eyes revealed a look of admiration and admiration.

Then, he continued, “This white fog is known as the Initial Fog!”
